title: Saturday Services hub pages
description: Each entry in `links` is one full-viewport page on the hub, after the Saturday Services hero.

vertical.description: shakes | solutions | mn. Sets the page skin (colour, fonts, mark) and the URL (#shakes).

theme.description: day = this house's app logos are dark line art; the hub turns them light in dark mode (M&N).

logo.description: Page mark, shown below the header with an accent glow. Clickable when `link` is set and status is live.

link.description: Direct app URL for single-app pages; null when the page has options or is coming soon

options.description: Sub-apps shown as clickable glowing marks (e.g. Backbar + Flavour Studio; future game sub-logos)

subtitle.description: Optional script-face subtitle under the option label (e.g. 'Finance Tracker')

logoTone.description: light = the logo is drawn in white or pale colours; the hub puts it on a dark tile in the light theme so it stays visible.
